hybrid.military: same public-observation candidate builder for heuristic and Jev

pureJev.diplomacy: finite proposal/accept/decline/peace/war choices; no generated messages

primaryEndpoint: authoritative final own industry; paired Jev-minus-heuristic difference by country/seed
secondaryEndpoints: mean own industry over played time

analysis.pairedPermutation: two-sided exact sign-flip on eight paired industry differences; no claim that other metrics are confirmatory
analysis.bootstrap: 10000 paired resamples with fixed seed 20260930; exploratory percentile interval
analysis.experimentalUnit: country/seed match block; model calls are not independent strength observations
analysis.missingResults: report all failures; do not count incomplete trials as losses; primary complete-pair analysis also reports worst/best missing-pair bounds when possible

constraints: No changes to engine, map, bots, normal game clock or live deployment
Separate isolated HTTP servers and SQLite files
Same model and reasoning setting for baseline and hybrid planners
Shuffled option order independent of heuristic score
No hidden state in model inputs
No synthetic provider fallback counted as Jev
Pilot uses another seed and quick preset and is excluded from main results
Freeze implementation and this protocol before main trials; no outcome-based tuning
Publish only allowlisted aggregate evidence; raw sessions and chats remain ignored
limitations: Eight blocks are a pilot-scale estimate, not a robust general win rate
One planner model and one seed per country
Concurrent API requests may affect latency
Baseline-to-hybrid changes strategy interface and action cadence; heuristic-to-Jev isolates the selector within the hybrid architecture
Plans are independently model-generated, so matched starts do not ensure identical plans
Bots do not reproduce human diplomacy
Candidate menu excludes long-distance offensive marches and army turn-around; baseline retains them
No human enjoyment or game balance claims
